sourcing_methodology: See SOURCING.md for field definitions and the source-priority process used to fill every entry below.

skis.name: Nordica Enforcer 94
skis.notes: 2 sheets titanal, Pulse Core elastomer layer. rocker_percent estimated from profile category (no published tip/camber/tail % breakdown). Blister's measured waist (95mm) rounded to the catalog nominal 94mm to match the model name.

skis.name: Nordica Enforcer 104 Free
skis.notes: 2-layer titanal, same construction family as Enforcer 94 but more tip/tail rocker. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Nordica Unleashed 98
skis.notes: Single layer 'Terrain Specific Metal' - thinner at center, extends near edge-to-edge at tips/tails: partial, not a full flat sheet. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Nordica Unleashed 108
skis.notes: Same Terrain Specific Metal concept as Unleashed 98, proportionally more metal underfoot given the wider waist. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: K2 Mindbender 90Ti
skis.notes: Ti Y-Beam construction. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: K2 Mindbender 99Ti
skis.notes: Titanal Y-Beam runs edge-to-edge underfoot. Measured tip/camber/tail splay 64mm / ~4mm / 20mm. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: K2 Mindbender 108Ti
skis.notes: Titanal Y-Beam construction. Measured tip/camber/tail splay 64mm / 4mm / 19.5mm. rocker_percent estimated from profile category. Blister's measured waist (107.4mm) rounded to the catalog nominal 108mm to match the model name.

skis.name: K2 Mindbender 116C
skis.notes: 'C' = carbon build, no titanal (vs the 'Ti' Mindbenders). 'Powder rocker' with deeper tip rocker than the Ti models; rocker_percent nudged above the category default for that reason.

skis.name: Blizzard Bonafide 97
skis.notes: 2 full sheets titanal (TrueBlend construction). Mostly full camber with all-mountain tip rocker + slight tail rocker - nudged below category default. rocker_percent estimated.

skis.name: Blizzard Brahma 88
skis.notes: 2 full sheets titanal + carbon fiber tips. v3 has 'much shallower rocker lines' than prior versions - nudged below category default. rocker_percent estimated.

skis.name: Blizzard Rustler 9
skis.notes: 2 pieces titanal full length + separate titanal plate underfoot. Measured camber underfoot 3mm. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Blizzard Rustler 11
skis.notes: Rustler 9's review states the 9 'uses more metal than the 10 or 11' - the 11 is FluxForm woodcore, no titanal sheet. Weight is the closest available length (186cm, 2070-2085g); confidence lower than most entries. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Blizzard Sheeva 9
skis.notes: Women's version of Rustler 9; FluxForm W.S.D. with 2 titanal plates full length. Weight figure had a per-pair/per-ski ambiguity in the source; used the per-ski reading consistent with the Rustler 9 pattern. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Volkl Mantra M6
skis.notes: Tailored Titanal Frame: one full-length layer below the core plus length-tuned segmented pieces above - has a genuine full sheet, unlike Kendo/Secret's frame-only design. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Volkl Katana 108
skis.notes: Full titanal sheet on the base + partial segmented sheet on top. 3D radius sidecut: 19m underfoot / 39m & 34m at tip & tail - turn_radius_m records the underfoot number. Mostly camber with low-rise tip/tail rocker, nudged below category default.

skis.name: Volkl Kendo 88
skis.notes: 0.7mm 'Titanal Frame' explicitly described as perimeter/sidewall reinforcement 'rather than the heavy, full width design of past years' - partial, not full. Weight varies 1900-2200g across sources/years; used the most recent figure. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Volkl Secret 92
skis.notes: Women's line; reference length is shorter (163cm) since that's what's available/reviewed for this model. Same 0.7mm 'Titanal Frame' (partial, not full-width) as Kendo 88. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Atomic Bent 100
skis.notes: Published tip/camber/tail split 20/65/15% - rocker_percent = 20+15. No metal; 11mm camber underfoot.

skis.name: Atomic Bent 110
skis.notes: Published tip/camber/tail split 25/50/25% - rocker_percent = 25+25. Measured tip/tail splay 62mm/58mm, camber underfoot 8mm. Weight is Atomic's stated pair weight (3500g) halved - flagged lower confidence than a directly measured per-ski figure.

skis.name: Atomic Vantage 97 Ti
skis.notes: 'Titanium Tank Mesh' is an explicit mesh, not a full sheet - partial. Published tip/camber/tail split 15/75/10% - rocker_percent = 15+10.

skis.name: Atomic Maverick 95 Ti
skis.notes: 2 full sheets of thin (0.4mm) titanal. Published tip/camber/tail split 20/70/10% - rocker_percent = 20+10.

skis.name: Salomon QST 98
skis.notes: Carbon/flax construction, no titanal sheet (QST line's defining trait vs. the metal Stance line). rocker_percent estimated from profile category - deeper rocker than the QST 99 it replaced.

skis.name: Salomon QST 106
skis.notes: Carbon/flax construction; source describes it as 'mainly titanal-free' aside from an incidental binding-area plate, treated as none consistent with the QST line's no-metal positioning. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Salomon QST Blank
skis.notes: Full poplar wood core, no metal. Measured camber underfoot 5.5mm (small but positive, keeping it camber_tip_tail_rocker rather than flat/full-rocker). Described as deeper-rockered than the QST 106 but not as deep as the QST 118 - rocker_percent nudged above category default. Weight varies significantly by model year (2070-2265g); used the 2025 figure.

skis.name: Salomon Stance 96
skis.notes: Full sheet titanal under the core plus a second titanal layer, and carbon/flax CFX inserts at tip/tail. Published split: 17% tip rocker / 12% tail rocker / rest camber - rocker_percent = 17+12.

skis.name: Rossignol Sender 94 Ti
skis.notes: 'Titanal Beam' runs underfoot only (localized, not a full sheet) - partial, corrected from an earlier 'full' assumption. Published Free Rocker split 25% tip / 60% camber / 15% tail - rocker_percent = 25+15.

skis.name: Rossignol Sender 104 Ti
skis.notes: Source explicitly states 'titanal (partial layer)' - corrected from an earlier 'full' assumption. Published Free Rocker split 25% tip / 60% camber / 15% tail - rocker_percent = 25+15. Measured camber underfoot 6.5mm.

skis.name: Head Kore 93
skis.notes: Corrected from 'none' - core is karuba/poplar + graphene + a titanal binding-area reinforcement plate + carbon/fiberglass, not metal-free despite the 'Graphene' marketing. Measured tip/tail splay 60mm/21mm, camber underfoot 5mm. Blister's measured waist (94.6mm) rounded to the catalog nominal 93mm to match the model name - the largest measured/nominal gap in the dataset.

skis.name: Head Kore 105
skis.notes: Same construction family as Kore 93: graphene + titanal binding-area reinforcement, not metal-free. Source weight figure (3750 at 180cm) read as a per-pair number for consistency with the rest of the Kore line; halved here.

skis.name: DPS Pagoda Tour 100
skis.notes: Aerospace-grade foam core, no metal. Dramatically tapered, deep tip rocker with a less radical tail - freeride/backcountry 'RP' design philosophy, flatter than typical all-mountain skis. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Line Sick Day 94
skis.notes: Aspenlite (100% aspen) core + Carbon Magic Fingers, no metal laminate. turn_radius_m not published for this length - estimated from comparable ~94mm all-mountain skis in the dataset, lower confidence than most entries. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Line Sick Day 104
skis.notes: Same Aspenlite/Carbon Magic Fingers construction as Sick Day 94, no metal. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Elan Ripstick 96
skis.notes: Poplar/paulownia core + carbon/fiberglass, no titanal mentioned. Elan's 'Amphibio' asymmetric tip/tail rocker (longer camber line on inside edges) - modeled here as the standard camber_tip_tail_rocker category since the app doesn't have an asymmetric-rocker axis. turn_radius_m sourced at 175cm, closest available to the 181cm weight figure. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Elan Ripstick 106
skis.notes: Same Amphibio/TNT Technology family as Ripstick 96, no metal. Described as shallower tip and tail rocker lines than most ~106mm skis - rocker_percent nudged below category default. turn_radius_m not published for this length - estimated from the Ripstick 96 and comparable ~106mm skis, lower confidence.

skis.name: Armada ARV 96 Ti
skis.notes: The 'Ti' variant (vs. the metal-free ARV 96) - full titanal laminate. Mellow tip/tail rocker with 6-7mm of camber underfoot - rocker_percent nudged below category default. turn_radius_m sourced at 177cm, close to the 184cm weight figure.

skis.name: Armada Tracer 108
skis.notes: Titanal reinforcement underfoot and sidewall only (not a full sheet) - partial. Freeride-oriented, deeper rocker than a typical all-mountain ski at this width - rocker_percent nudged above category default.

skis.name: Faction Agent 100
skis.notes: Faction has since renamed this line to 'Agent 1' - kept the 'Agent 100' naming here since it's what's documented/searchable historically; a future refresh should check whether 'Agent 1' specs differ meaningfully. Paulownia/carbon core, no metal. Camber with tip rocker and a flat (not rockered) tail - camber_tip_rocker, not camber_tip_tail_rocker. weight_g and turn_radius_m are estimated (interpolated from the women's Agent 100W figure and comparable skis) - lower confidence than most entries.

skis.name: Faction Prodigy 2
skis.notes: Full poplar/beech core, no metal. turn_radius_m sourced from a newer (2026-2027) model year at 171cm, closest available reference. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Black Crows Corvus
skis.notes: Current version dropped from 2 full titanal sheets to 1 titanal plate - described as a 'plate' rather than an edge-to-edge sheet, so classified partial; some ambiguity here since the source doesn't fully specify coverage. weight_g interpolated between the 176cm (3700g/pair) and 183cm (3900g/pair) figures, halved.

skis.name: Black Crows Camox
skis.notes: Poplar core + fiberglass, no titanal - confirmed metal-free. Shallow rocker lines with close to 10mm of camber underfoot (more than most skis in the dataset) - rocker_percent nudged well below category default.

skis.name: Fischer Ranger 96
skis.notes: Titanal split in front of/behind the binding area (not a full sheet) - partial, confirmed by source. turn_radius_m not published for this length - estimated from comparable ~96mm skis, lower confidence. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Fischer Ranger 108
skis.notes: Same split/partial titanal construction as the Ranger 96, proportionally less coverage on the wider ski. Deep tip rocker, shallower tail rocker line.

skis.name: Dynastar M-Pro 99
skis.notes: Wider metal sheet behind the binding, narrower strip in front, tapering toward tip/tail - partial. Moderately deep tip rocker, fairly subtle tail rocker - rocker_percent nudged below category default.

skis.name: Dynastar M-Pro 108
skis.notes: Beech/PU core + partial titanal layer (confirmed by source), fiberglass laminate. Measured camber underfoot 6mm, tip/tail splay 68mm/26mm. weight_g is estimated (not published at this length) by scaling from the M-Pro 99 - lower confidence. Reference length (192cm) is longer than most entries since that's the only length Blister published specs for.

skis.name: Moment Wildcat 108
skis.notes: Paulownia/ash core, no metal mentioned - consistent with Moment's typical construction. Source's weight figure (3.9kg) read as a per-pair number given how implausible 3.9kg/ski would be; halved here. Tip/tail rocker lines described as unusually deep for the width - rocker_percent nudged above category default. turn_radius_m estimated from comparable ~108mm skis, lower confidence.

skis.name: Liberty Origin 96
skis.notes: Bamboo/carbon construction, no metal. Tip rocker + solid cambered midsection + low-rise rockered tail - rocker_percent nudged below category default for the low-rise tail.

skis.name: Nordica Santa Ana 88
skis.notes: Women's line (Enforcer/Unleashed's counterpart); reference length is short (164cm) since that's what's available/tested for this model, same pattern as Secret 92 and Sheeva 9 elsewhere in the dataset. Same 'Terrain-Specific Metal' partial titanal concept as the Unleashed line - narrower Santa Ana models carry proportionally more metal coverage. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Salomon QST Lumen 99
skis.notes: Women's QST line; same no-metal carbon/poplar construction philosophy as the men's QST 98/106/Blank. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: Blizzard Zero G 105
skis.notes: Touring-oriented; full paulownia core + Carbon Drive layup, no metal. Fills a light/playful gap next to DPS Pagoda Tour 100 at a wider waist. rocker_percent estimated from profile category.

skis.name: K2 Reckoner 102
skis.notes: Carbon/Titanal hybrid construction (not a traditional full sheet) - partial. Notable camber underfoot, but pretty deep rocker lines for its width - rocker_percent nudged above category default. K2's freestyle-leaning all-mountain line, distinct from the Mindbender family.
